description: Tell the human how a task went, in person, with the urgency chosen for you from the outcome: `failed` and `needs_input` are loud enough to cut through quiet hours, `succeeded` is not. Pass the task name, the outcome, and optionally how long it took and where to look. This is the right tool at the end of anything long enough that the person walked away from it. Returns the queued announcement.

detail.description: One short clause of context ("3 tests failing", "waiting on your approval").

key.description: Dedupe key, so a retry loop reporting the same result says it once.

outcome.description: How it ended. Drives importance, tone and gesture.

seconds.description: How long it took, in seconds. Rendered as "in 4m" when given.

task.description: What was being done, in human words ("the nightly backfill", "your test suite").

url.description: Where to look: the run, the diff, the dashboard.

name: announce_result
title: Report a finished task in person
